data.body: Final budget-escalation result: 64k also failed. Exact command: `rtk proxy env REBAR_LLM_MAX_TOKENS=64000 PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/rebar verify-completion 3ba4-c0d1-1813-44a5 --ref origin/main --source attested --output json`. It ran silently for roughly nine minutes, then exited 1 with the same `decide@then/verify` / `finish_reason=length` truncation error and again emitted no verdict, trace metadata, or attestation. Observed sequence is therefore 16k default -> truncated, 32k -> truncated, 64k -> truncated. Raising the cap by 4x does not provide a viable recovery and materially increases latency; the workflow needs bounded evidence/output or a split/recovery path.
